info.name: TrueLern LMS API - Synchronized Production Collection
info.description:
Complete, synchronized, production-accurate Postman collection for TrueLern LMS / LMSCA backend API (v2.1.0).

Updated: 2026-10-07
Course-Aware Demo Scheduling update.

NEW:
- GET /api/parent/demo/courses (Loads published courses for parent demo booking)
- GET /api/crm/demos/smart-schedule (Admin Course-aware smart scheduling & conflict resolution; route implements GET per app/api/crm/demos/smart-schedule/route.ts)
- POST /api/crm/demos/schedule-for-child (Admin schedules DemoSession for child with course, teacher & time)
- POST /api/parent/demo/[id]/child-token (Child-scoped Jitsi demo participant token for authorized parent)
- POST /api/teacher/demo/[id]/token (Secure teacher-scoped Jitsi token for assigned demo session)

UPDATED:
- GET /api/parent/demo/availability (+ courseId={{courseId}} query parameter, backward-compatible program fallback)

All routes mapped from actual Next.js app/api/** endpoints with dual Bearer token & Cookie auth support.

**Purpose:** Admin schedules a DemoSession for a specific child using the selected Course/Program, teacher, and scheduled time.

- `studentId` (string, optional): Student/Child ObjectId
- `teacherId` (string, optional): Assigned Teacher ObjectId (auto-resolved from course batches if omitted)
